args: const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os'),path=require('path');function xp(s){s=s.replace(/%([A-Za-z0-9_]+)%/g,(_,n)=>process.env[n]||'').replace(/\$\{([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\}/g,(_,n)=>process.env[n]||'');if(s.charAt(0)==='~')s=os.homedir()+s.slice(1);return s;}let r=process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.FLC_TOOLS_PLUGIN_DIR;if(!r){try{const m=fs.readFileSync(path.join(os.homedir(),'.config','flc-tools-knowledge-mcp.env'),'utf8').match(/^FLC_TOOLS_PLUGIN_DIR=(.+)$/m);if(m)r=m[1].trim();}catch(e){}}if(!r){console.error('FLC Tools MCP: set FLC_TOOLS_PLUGIN_DIR in ~/.config/flc-tools-knowledge-mcp.env');process.exit(1);}r=xp(r);if(!path.isAbsolute(r))r=path.join(os.homedir(),r);import(require('url').pathToFileURL(path.join(r,'scripts','launch-flc-tools-knowledge-mcp.mjs')).href);
